mapper.select: SELECT t.exam_id AS examId, SUM(t.enroll_count) AS enrollCount, SUM(t.participant_count) AS participantCount FROM ( SELECT exam_id, COUNT(*) AS enroll_count, 0 AS participant_count FROM tb_user_exam WHERE GROUP BY exam_id UNION ALL SELECT exam_id, 0, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_submit WHERE GROUP BY exam_id ) t GROUP BY t.exam_id
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_exam WHERE ) AS enrollCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_submit WHERE ) AS participantCount
